title: Tri-Delta sorority building in Cornell Heights Historic District, Ithaca, Tompkins County
author: Jerrye & Roy Klotz, MD
description: THIS AREA DEVELOPED CIRCA 1898 DUE TO EXPANSION OF CORNELL UNIVERSITY. THE PREVIOUSLY BARREN HILLSIDE WAS DEVELOPED BECAUSE OF 2 BRIDGES SPANNING FALL CREEK AND THE EXTENSION OF TROLLEY LINES. MANY STRUCTURES FEATURE TUDOR REVIVAL STYLE AND ARE LANDMARK HOME OR FRATERNITY HOUSES. THIS FRATERNITY HOUSE ISLOCATED AT 118 TRIPHAMMER ROAD

title: Kappa Delta Sorority, Cornell University
author: Kenneth C. Zirkel
